api_key.hint: Enter the API key here, or leave empty to read the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable.

base_url.hint: Include /v1, not /images/generations. Reference images require JSON support for /images/edits.

timeout_seconds.hint: Timeout for the background Image API request. The tool returns immediately; no increase to AstrBot tool timeout is needed. Failed requests are not automatically retried.

max_storage_gb.hint: Before each API request, if total archive file size exceeds this limit, delete oldest request directories until below it. Current and queued requests are protected. New images may exceed the limit until the next request.
